entries.title: Psalms 9:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. Upon Muthlabben. A Psalm of David.>> I will praise Jehovah with my whole heart; I will recount all thy marvellous works.

entries.title: Psalms 9:2
segments: I will be glad and rejoice in thee; I will sing forth thy name, O Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 9:3
segments: When mine enemies turned back, they stumbled and perished at thy presence:

entries.title: Psalms 9:4
segments: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause. Thou sittest on the throne, judging righteously.

entries.title: Psalms 9:5
segments: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:6
segments: O enemy! destructions are ended for ever. --Thou hast also destroyed cities, even the remembrance of them hath perished.

entries.title: Psalms 9:7
segments: But Jehovah sitteth for ever; he hath ordained his throne for judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 9:8
segments: And it is he that will judge the world with righteousness; he shall execute judgment upon the peoples with equity.

entries.title: Psalms 9:9
segments: And Jehovah will be a refuge to the oppressed one, a refuge in times of distress.

entries.title: Psalms 9:10
segments: And they that know thy name will confide in thee; for thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

entries.title: Psalms 9:11
segments: ¶Sing psalms to Jehovah who dwelleth in Zion; tell among the peoples his doings.

entries.title: Psalms 9:12
segments: For when he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them; the cry of the afflicted ones hath he not forgotten.

entries.title: Psalms 9:13
segments: Be gracious unto me, O Jehovah; consider mine affliction from them that hate me, lifting me up from the gates of death:

entries.title: Psalms 9:14
segments: That I may declare all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will be joyful in thy salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 9:15
segments: The nations are sunk down in the pit [that] they made; in the net that they hid is their own foot taken.

entries.title: Psalms 9:16
segments: Jehovah is known [by] the judgment he hath executed: the wicked is ensnared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 9:17
segments: The wicked shall be turned into Sheol, all the nations that forget God.

entries.title: Psalms 9:18
segments: For the needy one shall not be forgotten alway; the hope of the meek shall not perish for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:19
segments: Arise, Jehovah; let not man prevail: let the nations be judged in thy sight.

entries.title: Psalms 9:20
segments: Put them in fear, Jehovah: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
